about.description: INTW is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on KuCoin, tracking GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
